text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The second leg of the Triple Tiara route, 
the Oaks. Fine Motion shows no signs of 
nerves, appearing just as cheerful as 
ever.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However,
an Umamusume who was watching her 
and trembling during the Oka Sho says:
She 
can afford to stay relaxed because even
if 
she loses the race, she has other futures 
available to her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion affirmed those words. To her, 
every race was enjoyable and free of 
worry.
Yet she understood just how special 
this race truly was.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her time is limited... That is precisely 
why she poured everything she had into 
this moment,
hoping that the other runners 
would give their absolute best as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion's honest feelings reminded 
that Umamusume to run true to herself.
And 
so, the curtain rose on the race...
